run_vggsfm_demo: run the VGGSfM demo pipeline on a scene directory with images and optional masks
initialize_vggsfm_runner: initialize the VGGSfMRunner class with a configuration object for sparse and dense reconstruction
load_scene_data: load scene data from a directory using DemoLoader with configurable image size and ground truth loading
seed_random_engines: seed all random number generators in torch and numpy for reproducible results
run_vggsfm_pipeline: run the VGGSfM pipeline on images with masks, crop parameters, and output directory for reconstruction
